statements.query: MATCH ((n:EC2Instance)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:AWSAccount{id: $AWS_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:AWSOrganization{id: $ORGANIZATION_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID})) where n.exposed_internet IS NOT NULL WITH n LIMIT $LIMIT_SIZE REMOVE n.exposed_internet, n.exposed_internet_type, n.publicContext return COUNT(*) as TotalCompleted

MATCH (cidr:IpRange{range:'0.0.0.0/0'})-[:MEMBER_OF_IP_RULE]->(perm:IpPermissionInbound)-[:MEMBER_OF_EC2_SECURITY_GROUP]->(sg:EC2SecurityGroup)<-[:MEMBER_OF_EC2_SECURITY_GROUP]-(elb:LoadBalancer{scheme: 'internet-facing'})-[:EXPOSE]->(instance:EC2Instance{state: 'running'})<-[:RESOURCE]-(:AWSAccount{id: $AWS_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:AWSOrganization{id: $ORGANIZATION_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID})
 SET instance.exposed_internet = true,(CASE WHEN NOT 'unrestricted_inbound_traffic_ipv4' IN  coalesce(instance.exposed_internet_type , []) THEN instance END).exposed_internet_type = coalesce(instance.exposed_internet_type , []) + 'unrestricted_inbound_traffic_ipv4'

MATCH (cidr:Ipv6Range{range:'::/0'})-[:MEMBER_OF_IP_RULE]->(perm:IpPermissionInbound)-[:MEMBER_OF_EC2_SECURITY_GROUP]->(sg:EC2SecurityGroup)<-[:MEMBER_OF_EC2_SECURITY_GROUP]-(elb:LoadBalancer{scheme: 'internet-facing'})-[:EXPOSE]->(instance:EC2Instance{state: 'running'})<-[:RESOURCE]-(:AWSAccount{id: $AWS_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:AWSOrganization{id: $ORGANIZATION_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID})
SET instance.exposed_internet = true,(CASE WHEN NOT 'unrestricted_inbound_traffic_ipv6' IN  coalesce(instance.exposed_internet_type , []) THEN instance END).exposed_internet_type = coalesce(instance.exposed_internet_type , []) + 'unrestricted_inbound_traffic_ipv6'

MATCH (cidr:IpRange{range:'0.0.0.0/0'})-[:MEMBER_OF_IP_RULE]->(perm:IpPermissionInbound)-[:MEMBER_OF_EC2_SECURITY_GROUP]->(sg:EC2SecurityGroup)<-[:MEMBER_OF_EC2_SECURITY_GROUP]-(elbv2:LoadBalancerV2{scheme: 'internet-facing'})-[:EXPOSE]->(instance:EC2Instance{state: 'running'})<-[:RESOURCE]-(:AWSAccount{id: $AWS_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:AWSOrganization{id: $ORGANIZATION_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID})
SET instance.exposed_internet = true,(CASE WHEN NOT 'unrestricted_inbound_traffic_ipv4' IN  coalesce(instance.exposed_internet_type , []) THEN instance END).exposed_internet_type = coalesce(instance.exposed_internet_type , []) + 'unrestricted_inbound_traffic_ipv4'

MATCH (cidr:Ipv6Range{range:'::/0'})-[:MEMBER_OF_IP_RULE]->(perm:IpPermissionInbound)-[:MEMBER_OF_EC2_SECURITY_GROUP]->(sg:EC2SecurityGroup)<-[:MEMBER_OF_EC2_SECURITY_GROUP]-(elbv2:LoadBalancerV2{scheme: 'internet-facing'})-[:EXPOSE]->(instance:EC2Instance{state: 'running'})<-[:RESOURCE]-(:AWSAccount{id: $AWS_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:AWSOrganization{id: $ORGANIZATION_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID})
SET instance.exposed_internet = true,(CASE WHEN NOT 'unrestricted_inbound_traffic_ipv6' IN  coalesce(instance.exposed_internet_type , []) THEN instance END).exposed_internet_type = coalesce(instance.exposed_internet_type , []) + 'unrestricted_inbound_traffic_ipv6'

statements.__comment: An NLB without a security group (created before August 2023) forwards its listener ports from anywhere, so the SG statements above never match the instances behind it. ALBs always have a security group, so only NLBs qualify.
statements.query: MATCH (elbv2:LoadBalancerV2{scheme: 'internet-facing', type: 'network'})-[:EXPOSE]->(instance:EC2Instance{state: 'running'})<-[:RESOURCE]-(:AWSAccount{id: $AWS_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:AWSOrganization{id: $ORGANIZATION_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID}) WHERE NOT EXISTS { MATCH (elbv2)-[:MEMBER_OF_EC2_SECURITY_GROUP]->(:EC2SecurityGroup) } WITH DISTINCT instance SET instance.exposed_internet = true,(CASE WHEN NOT 'internet_facing_nlb' IN coalesce(instance.exposed_internet_type , []) THEN instance END).exposed_internet_type = coalesce(instance.exposed_internet_type , []) + 'internet_facing_nlb'

MATCH (cidr:IpRange{range:'0.0.0.0/0'})-[:MEMBER_OF_IP_RULE]->(perm:IpPermissionInbound)-[:MEMBER_OF_EC2_SECURITY_GROUP]->(sg:EC2SecurityGroup)<-[:MEMBER_OF_EC2_SECURITY_GROUP]-(instance:EC2Instance{state: 'running'})<-[:RESOURCE]-(:AWSAccount{id: $AWS_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:AWSOrganization{id: $ORGANIZATION_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID}) WHERE instance.publicipaddress IS NOT NULL OR EXISTS { MATCH (instance)-[:NETWORK_INTERFACE]->(eni:NetworkInterface) WHERE eni.public_ip IS NOT NULL } OR EXISTS { MATCH (instance)-[:NETWORK_INTERFACE]->(:NetworkInterface)-[:PRIVATE_IP_ADDRESS]->(ip:EC2PrivateIp) WHERE ip.public_ip IS NOT NULL } WITH DISTINCT instance SET instance.exposed_internet = true,(CASE WHEN NOT 'direct_inbound_ipv4' IN coalesce(instance.exposed_internet_type , []) THEN instance END).exposed_internet_type = coalesce(instance.exposed_internet_type , []) + 'direct_inbound_ipv4'

MATCH (cidr:Ipv6Range{range:'::/0'})-[:MEMBER_OF_IP_RULE]->(perm:IpPermissionInbound)-[:MEMBER_OF_EC2_SECURITY_GROUP]->(sg:EC2SecurityGroup)<-[:MEMBER_OF_EC2_SECURITY_GROUP]-(instance:EC2Instance{state: 'running'})<-[:RESOURCE]-(:AWSAccount{id: $AWS_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:AWSOrganization{id: $ORGANIZATION_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID}) WHERE (instance.ipv6address IS NOT NULL AND instance.ipv6address <> '') OR EXISTS { MATCH (instance)-[:NETWORK_INTERFACE]->(eni:NetworkInterface) WHERE size(coalesce(eni.ipv6_addresses, [])) > 0 } WITH DISTINCT instance SET instance.exposed_internet = true,(CASE WHEN NOT 'direct_inbound_ipv6' IN coalesce(instance.exposed_internet_type , []) THEN instance END).exposed_internet_type = coalesce(instance.exposed_internet_type , []) + 'direct_inbound_ipv6'

MATCH (instance:EC2Instance)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:AWSAccount{id: $AWS_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:AWSOrganization{id: $ORGANIZATION_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID}) WHERE instance.exposed_internet = true WITH instance OPTIONAL MATCH (cidr)-[:MEMBER_OF_IP_RULE]->(rule:IpPermissionInbound)-[:MEMBER_OF_EC2_SECURITY_GROUP]->(sg:EC2SecurityGroup)<-[:MEMBER_OF_EC2_SECURITY_GROUP]-(instance) WHERE (cidr:IpRange AND cidr.range = '0.0.0.0/0') OR (cidr:Ipv6Range AND cidr.range = '::/0') WITH instance, sg, rule, cidr, (CASE WHEN cidr:IpRange THEN [cidr.range] WHEN cidr:Ipv6Range THEN [cidr.range] ELSE [] END) as ipRanges OPTIONAL MATCH (instance)-[:EXPOSE|MEMBER_AUTO_SCALE_GROUP*1..2]-(lb) WHERE lb:LoadBalancer OR lb:LoadBalancerV2 WITH instance, collect(DISTINCT {securityGroup: sg.id, port: toString(rule.fromport), protocol: rule.protocol, ipRanges: ipRanges, loadBalancer: lb.dnsname}) as sgRules SET instance.publicContext = apoc.convert.toJson([{resource: instance.id, resourceType: 'aws-compute-ec2-instance', context: [{instanceId: instance.id, publicIp: instance.publicipaddress, privateIp: instance.privateipaddress, state: instance.state, exposureTypes: instance.exposed_internet_type, securityExposure: sgRules}]}])
